hooks.command: FILE=$(jq -r '.tool_response.filePath // .tool_input.file_path' 2>/dev/null); echo "$FILE" | grep -qE '^knowledge/.*\.(artifact|verdict)\.md$' && { echo "=== PostToolUse hook: Validating knowledge artifact ===" && python3 scripts/general/check_knowledge_artifacts.py "$FILE" && python3 scripts/general/check_artifact_toc.py "$FILE"; } || true

FILE=$(jq -r '.tool_response.filePath // .tool_input.file_path' 2>/dev/null); echo "$FILE" | grep -qE '^openspec/changes/.*/draft\.md$' && { echo "=== PostToolUse hook: Validating draft diagram contracts ===" && python3 scripts/research/validate_draft_diagram_contract.py "$FILE"; } || true

FILE=$(jq -r '.tool_response.filePath // .tool_input.file_path' 2>/dev/null); echo "$FILE" | grep -qE '^(knowledge/|openspec/changes/).*\.md$' && { echo "=== PostToolUse hook: Validating document structure ===" && python3 scripts/general/check_document_structure.py "$FILE"; } || true
